text:
maria_user: Hey @support, our rerank calls started failing this morning. Getting a 400 with a vague message: "Bad Request" and no details. Happened after we bumped our candidate docs from 50 -> 300.

alex_support: Hi Maria — can you paste the exact response body and the request payload (or a redacted version)? Also which model and region are you hitting?

maria_user: Here's the error from our client logs: 
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "Bad Request"
}
```
Request (redacted):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "ri-rerank-v1",
  "query": "<redacted long user query>",
  "documents": ["<doc1 long text>", "<doc2 long text>", ..., "<doc300 long text>"]
}
```
We're on hosted, us-west. It started when we ramped docs per request.

alex_support: Thanks. No stack trace in the response is annoying. Can you run with debug=true header and share X-Request-Id from the failed call? That'll help us trace. Also roughly how long (characters) is each doc and the query length?

maria_user: Docs are ~6-8k chars each, query is ~1500 chars. I grabbed the request id: `req_9b3a1c2f`.

deploy_bot: New support ticket created SR-2026 for req_9b3a1c2f and routed to eng-oncall.

sara_engineer: Jumping in — this screams request size limits. Our rerank path currently enforces combined token limits across query + all docs. 300 docs * 2000 tokens each would explode it. Do you have a sample payload (one doc) we can repro with?

maria_user: I'll paste a single full doc to repro but redacted sensitive parts. Also note we got a separate 413 once for a similar attempt but most errors were 400.

alex_support: If you can reproduce with 10 docs that still fails, that'll be ideal for us. Also the 413 you saw is more correct for "payload too large." The inconsistent 400 vs 413 is likely a gateway vs runtime mismatch. I'll escalate.

jess_research: For troubleshooting: try truncating docs to first 1024 tokens or pre-filtering candidates. For our internal limits: current soft limits are 100 docs per rerank request and 4096 tokens total (query + docs) for hosted tier; Dedicated can be higher. We should confirm actual enforcement and return a clear error: something like `{"error": "request_too_large", "max_docs": "100", "max_total_tokens": "4096"}` so users can programmatically handle this.

sara_engineer: Confirmed on prod logs for req_9b3a1c2f: gateway rejected at nginx with 400 because client_max_body_size was exceeded on the LB for that request size. Later our runtime returned 413 for a different node. That's why the inconsistency. We need unified behaviour and better error text.

maria_user: Appreciate the details. For now any quick mitigation? We can't reduce doc count drastically without hurting quality.

jess_research: Options:
- paginate rerank: send top-K from retrieval in batches (e.g., 50 each) and merge scores client-side.
- pre-filter via embeddings: compute embeddings for docs, score quickly, then rerank top 100.
- compress docs: remove boilerplate, index metadata instead of full text.
- truncate or summarize docs server-side before rerank.

If you want, we can run a short eval script to find minimal doc count for stable MAP.

alex_support: I'm going to propose two immediate platform fixes in SR-2026: (1) ensure LB/gateway returns 413 consistently for oversize payloads, include structured JSON with max limits and a support URL; (2) add a validation layer in the rerank API that rejects early with a 400 and helpful payload if individual doc or query tokens exceed per-item caps. Will track with eng-oncall.

sara_engineer: Added to eng-oncall board: RERANK-176 unify oversize error handling + telemetry to catch top offending customers. Also adding a debug flag to return token counts in errors for troubleshooting.

maria_user: Thanks, team. One more ask — can the error include which part exceeded limits (e.g., "doc[57] too long (tokens: 5200)")? That would save us time.

jess_research: Agreed — returning per-item token counts is low-risk and high-value. We'll scope it with privacy in mind (no doc content), only size metrics and indices.

alex_support: For immediate help, try batching to <= 50 docs and trimming query to <= 512 tokens. I'll follow up in the SR with ETA on fixes.

maria_user: Will try batching and report back. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy_bot: SR-2026 status updated: escalated -> in progress (eng-oncall assigned: sara_engineer).
